slides.text: Gandhi in Bilaspur , November 24 When Gandhi had come to Chhattisgarh for the first time in 1920 under the Kandel Canal Satyagraha movement, he promised to come to Bilaspur soon at the request of the people of Bilaspur. Thirteen years had passed by the time Gandhi had promised to come to Bilaspur, but the people's craze for Gandhi had not diminished, and the proof of this is that like in Raipur, Dhamtari, Durg, people of Bilaspur and its surroundings started camping in Bilaspur weeks in advance to see and hear Gandhi as soon as the information of Gandhi's arrival was received. As soon as the information of Gandhi's arrival in Bilaspur was received, people in and around Bilaspur started camping in Bilaspur weeks before to see Gandhi.

slides.text: At seven o'clock, different groups of people turned into a massive crowd, there was no place to walk on the main road, and Gandhi's motor was crawling like an ant. Gandhi had come to Bilaspur in an open car, p eople were showering coins, which was also hurting Gandhi. There was a possibility of a crowd, so the group of volunteers surrounded the car.

slides.text: But the enthusiasm of the people and the desire to touch Gandhi was such that many volunteers were injured due to the brunt of the bumps and nails of the people. Yadunandan Prasad Srivastava, who was clearing the path in front of the car, got caught in the grip of the crowd so that his feet got uprooted from the ground and he got hit by the road. Gandhi was then sent to the residence of Kunjbehari Agnihotri for rest, where the cr owd was becoming uncontrollable, Gandhi had greeted the crowd present outside the window of the house.

slides.text: After the meal, on the same day , a meeting of women was organized in the Company Garden of the city which is now known as Vivekananda Udyan. Gandhi reached this meeting and for the collection of Tilak and Swaraj fund s , women presented him a bag full of 1000 rupees, which Gandhi considered very little as an aid to independence , and then the women immediately presented their jewelry to Gandhi. After this women's gathering meet, he has to left for addressing a public meeting in Bilaspur, and as Gandhi moved towards the car, one of his legs was on the foot of the car and the other was on the ground when someone caught his leg.
